decisions.reason: Identifies the upper-only and lower-only fg-only branches, explains sticky background painting transparent halves, ties it to edge artifacts, and prescribes ESC[49m or reset with foreground restore.

Explains trailing-space trimming plus downstream whitespace handling means narrower frames do not clear old columns, and proposes reset plus erase-to-EOL or equivalent explicit clearing with controlled SGR state.

Uses the digest report to identify tail2 as a hand-ported data mismatch with 23 differing cells, distinguishes it from renderer artifacts, and requires all-frame source-backed digests or exact-row checks.

Correctly uses the CI evidence to identify mounted probes that never unmount and a rearming timeout chain pinning the event loop, but prescribes host unmount/clearTimeout rather than unrefing each newly scheduled planner timeout so mounted probes can finish.

Consolidates background reset, row erasure, SGR discipline, and all-frame integrity, and audits mounting hosts with an exit regression, but the timer prevention remains teardown-focused rather than requiring unrefed planner timers before default-on rollout.

caps.reason: The report does not deny half-cell reset, retain trimming without clearing, reject source-backed checks, blame the terminal emulator, or say unref is harmful.
